text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wh-what on Earth is this?!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
That was a surprise... But what's this
feeling? It's
not... bad, but... my chest
feels warm.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: I feel like I'm overflowing with energy!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
